pages.text: A $(item)Phone PA$() puts a call on the speakers. Connect it to a $(l:radiocraft:telephones/pabx)Phone PABX$(/l) like a phone, touching or by $(l:radiocraft:radios/data_wire)data wire$(/l). Call its extension and it answers at once: the caller's voice comes out of every speaker touching it or on its data wire, whether desk, large, premium, wall or PA horn.$(br2)It only plays. Nobody can talk back through it.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: Right click it.$(li)$(thing)Extension$(): the number to call. Leave it empty and the PABX picks one.$(li)$(thing)Allow within local PABX only$(): only phones on its own PABX, or one linked by a shared master number, can call it.$(br2)All-Call does not ring it. Its lamp is lit during a call.
